description: List the learner's Memrise lessons (scenarios) of one type, newest completed first, with progress and the start and completion dates. type: 'completed' (default) or 'in_progress'. since: lessons completed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD = start of that day in the learner's time zone) or ISO datetime with offset. If some lesson details cannot be fetched, results are still returned without those lesson links and a `warnings` field names the failed lesson ids. The first call in a fresh process with a cold cache is noticeably slower because every completed lesson is fetched once; later calls are fast.
name: scenarios_list
title: List lessons
